definitions.gloss: route to school; designated school route
definitions.explanation: The road children take to and from school. In Japan, elementary schools designate official routes, marked with signs, that pupils are expected to use.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通学路|つうがくろ}です。
{通学路|つうがくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A traffic light was installed on the school route.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{通学路|つうがくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見守|みまも}っている→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧。
examples.english: In the mornings, local volunteers stand along the school route to watch over the children.

notes:
Road signs reading {通学路|つうがくろ} warn drivers that children walk there; some school routes ban cars during commuting hours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通学路|つうがくろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧: safety of the school route
- {通学路|つうがくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ / ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to walk / take the school route
- {通学路|つうがくろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見守|みまも}り→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧: volunteers watching over children on their way to school
